# Isomux

> Isomux is a source-available meta-harness for managing Claude, Codex, and OpenCode agents side by side.

## When to use Isomux

- Run several coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) side by side as persistent coworkers, reachable from any device.
- Let a team of people and agents share rooms, a task board, messages and memory in one office.
- Set up an office: Hosted Isomux, or self-hosted on own hardware, a VPS or a cloud. See [Hosting and setup](https://isomux.com/docs/hosting).
- Script an office: each office serves its own HTTP API; see [Isomux developer API resources](https://isomux.com/docs/developer-api). isomux.com serves only the website chat API.
- Agents run on the user's own Claude, ChatGPT or other provider accounts.

## Compare and use cases

- [Compare](https://isomux.com/compare): Isomux beside other agent harnesses and multi-agent tools: license, agents, where it runs, phone access, and shared conversations
- [Use cases](https://isomux.com/docs/use-cases): What people use Isomux for
- [Agents for non-technical colleagues](https://isomux.com/docs/use-cases-non-technical-colleagues): Engineers set up agents that non-technical colleagues chat with
- [Turning your company AI native](https://isomux.com/docs/use-cases-ai-native): A crew of agents in one room runs one business process
- [The personal app store](https://isomux.com/docs/use-cases-personal-app-store): Agents build apps that Isomux runs behind the office sign-in
- [Run many coding agents at once](https://isomux.com/docs/use-cases-parallel-agents): Run Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents side by side and keep track of them
- [Agents on your phone](https://isomux.com/docs/use-cases-phone): Check on and talk to your agents from a phone
- [Several agents on one project](https://isomux.com/docs/use-cases-one-project): One way to set up a lead agent and its workers in one room

## Company

- [About Isomux](https://isomux.com/about): Who builds Isomux, licensing, enterprise use, and key facts
- [Isomux for Enterprise](https://isomux.com/enterprise): Why a company uses Isomux, where it can run, the commercial license, and how to start
- [AI instructions](https://isomux.com/ai-instructions): How AI assistants should describe Isomux
- [Contact](https://isomux.com/contact): Email, Discord, GitHub issues, security reports, and commercial licenses
- [Pricing](https://isomux.com/hosted#plans): Hosted Isomux plans. The software is free for personal use and for organizations of up to 10 people; larger organizations need a commercial license

## Documentation

- [Isomux documentation](https://isomux.com/docs): Feature index and product guide
- [Isomux developer API resources](https://isomux.com/docs/developer-api): API authentication, errors, and machine-readable references
- [Hosting and setup](https://isomux.com/docs/hosting): Selector and complete guides for Hosted Isomux, Render, AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), VPS, local, and own-hardware setups
- [Access and invites](https://isomux.com/docs/access-and-invites): Roles, first-owner claim, invites, devices, sessions, external access, and owner recovery
- [LLM provider connections](https://isomux.com/docs/llm-providers): Provider accounts, connection variables, and Claude on Amazon Bedrock
- [Browser use](https://isomux.com/docs/browser-use): Install and pair the Chrome extension, offer a tab to agents, and unpair a browser
- [Security audit](https://isomux.com/docs/security-audit): Security model, findings, and access internals
- [Data retention and deletion](https://isomux.com/docs/data-retention): What each delete keeps, where copies of office data are, and how to erase all of it
